USC researchers, alongside Quantum Elements, have demonstrated scalable surface‑code error correction on IBM’s heavy‑hex qubit processors, advancing the field toward fault‑tolerant quantum computing.  The experiment shows improved logical qubit performance through effective hardware‑software integration and highlights critical progress in near‑term scalable architectures.  Global coverage of this milestone is aggregated by Google News.
